question: Should this persistent-store initialization fix merge with its local six-process proof, or should maintainers require a concurrent object-storage run before accepting the remaining availability risk?
rationale: The proposed path affects the startup availability of a persistent store, while the supplied real-runtime evidence covers only a local LanceDB directory even though the extension supports object-storage configuration.

options.title: Require object-store proof
options.body: Run the same bounded concurrent-initialization scenario against a representative supported object-store URI before merge.

options.title: Accept the scoped residual risk
